title: The vision for Terafab, Elon Musk's Texas factory
title_candidates: Inside the factory Elon Musk is building to be the largest on Earth

How big Tesla's Texas factory is actually going to get
The factory where Elon Musk plans to build robots, rockets, and cars under one roof
caption:
Tesla's Terafab in Texas is being built to be the largest building on Earth, bigger than most major airports.

The facility is designed to house manufacturing for Tesla vehicles, Optimus humanoid robots, and other hardware all under one roof. At that scale, it would be a concentration of industrial output unlike anything ever attempted in one building.

Elon Musk says it will also become the most economically valuable piece of real estate on the planet when finished.
